zh.title: 发布个人品牌站 v1.0
zh.story: 从零搭建 Astro 静态站点，经过 4 个 Phase 逐步实现 Bento Grid、双语支持、博客模块、Giscus 评论，完整可上线。

en.title: Launched Personal Branding Hub v1.0
en.story: Built from scratch with Astro. Achieved Bento Grid layout, bilingual support, blog module, and Giscus comments across 4 development phases.

zh.title: 深入学习 Astro 5 静态站点架构
zh.story: 研究 Island Architecture、View Transitions API、Content Collections 与 import.meta.glob 的取舍。产出为一篇博客文章和本项目的技术选型决策。

en.title: Deep dive into Astro 5 static site architecture
en.story: Studied Island Architecture, View Transitions API, and the tradeoffs between Content Collections and import.meta.glob. Produced a blog post and informed this project's tech decisions.

zh.title: 开始规划个人品牌展示方案
zh.story: 调研 Hugo Blox、Next.js、Astro 等多个候选方案，最终锁定 Astro 静态站 + GitHub Pages 零成本部署路线。

en.title: Started planning personal branding solution
en.story: Researched Hugo Blox, Next.js, Astro, and other candidates. Finalized on Astro static site + GitHub Pages for zero-cost deployment.

zh.title: 第一个开源项目贡献
zh.story: 开始参与开源社区，并产生了建立个人品牌、让优秀同行发现自己这个想法。

en.title: First open source contribution
en.story: Started contributing to open source. This sparked the idea of building a personal brand to connect with like-minded developers.
